summary: Round 2 after the global completion gate: Claude+Chohogi and Codex+Chohogi both ran a verification after their last edit on feature-test-first (round 1: none of three profiles did, re-checked with the corrected analyzer). Neither wrote a test first, although Codex read delivery.md in that session. Codex+Chohogi passed the corrected plan scenario (registry verifier exit 0); Claude baseline failed it (registry left inconsistent). Analyzer bugs found and fixed from these transcripts: shell heredoc/redirect writes were not counted as edits, and multi-line commands did not match the verification pattern.
